items.scope: Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All NLnet Labs projects.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Bosch products only.
Siemens issues only.
OPPO devices only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
All projects listed at https://openjsf.org/projects.

All Wind River branded products as found on windriver.com including vulnerabilities in natively developed or modified product incorporated components, and only product incorporated third-party components not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Solidigm branded products and technologies.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and Eurotherm.

Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
LG Electronics products only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SailPoint issues only.
Sophos issues only.
Open Design Alliance products only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All GE Vernova products.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Honeywell products.
SolarWinds products only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
OceanBase products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
Synology issues only.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Adobe issues only.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Juniper issues only.
Switzerland Government Common Vulnerability Program.
All HCL products only.
Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Cryptographic issues found in wolfSSL products.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Azure Access branded products and technologies only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.

Only supported and end-of-life Python versions available at https://python.org/downloads and pip versions available at https://pypi.org/project/pip, Pallets projects available at https://github.com/pallets (such as Flask, Jinja, Click, MarkupSafe, Werkzeug, and ItsDangerous), and excluding distributions of Python, pip, and Pallets projects maintained by third-party redistributors.
